✅️ /-!Nonreflexive constructor transport for a dependent state-indexed finite
    field. The function observation distinguishes backward, forward and unchanged
    argument transport. -/
✅️ set_option autoImplicit false
✅️ set_option warningAsError true
✅️ namespace Examples.CubicalConstructorState
✅️ open CategoryTheory SquareKit.Cubical SquareKit.Cubical.Presheaf
✅️ open CubicalStatePackageUa CubicalStateTransport CubicalUnivalenceTransport CubicalGlue
✅️ open SmallUniverse

✅️ abbrev Ξ :=
      raisedContext terminal.{0}

✅️ noncomputable def carrierPath :=
      Univalence.ua (constantLocal terminal Int).code (constantLocal terminal Int).code (codeIso successor).hom
        (HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (codeIso successor))

✅️ noncomputable abbrev a :=
      LargeConstructors.inputLine carrierPath

✅️ noncomputable abbrev A :=
      liftedDecode a

✅️ noncomputable def linePresentation :
        A ≅ constantFamily (total (interval Ξ)) (ULift.{1} Int) :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (raisedIntervalIso terminal).inv.mapElements (Raising.iso successorLineIso)

✅️ noncomputable def smallIndex :
        Term (constantFamily (total successorLine.family) Int) :=
      Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (projection successorLine.family).mapElements successorLineIso.hom)
        (generic successorLine.family)

✅️ noncomputable def smallField : LocalFamily (total successorLine.family) :=
      LocalFamily.discrete smallIndex (fun n => Fin (n.natAbs + 1))

✅️ noncomputable def display : total A ⟶ raisedContext (total successorLine.family) :=
      liftSub (Raising.family successorLine.family) (raisedIntervalIso terminal).inv ≫
        (Raising.totalIso successorLine.family).inv

✅️ noncomputable def b : total A ⟶ smallFamilyCodes.{0} :=
      display ≫ smallField.code

✅️ noncomputable abbrev B :=
      liftedDecode b

✅️ noncomputable def fieldPresentation :
        B ≅ reindex (Raising.family smallField.family) display :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft display.mapElements (Raising.iso smallField.decodeCodeIso)

✅️ private def numericValue (n : Int) : Fin (n.natAbs + 1) :=
      ⟨n.natAbs - 1, by omega⟩

✅️ private theorem cast_numericValue (n m : Int) (h : n = m) :
        cast (congrArg (fun k : Int => Fin (k.natAbs + 1)) h) (numericValue n) = numericValue m :=
      by
      cases h
      rfl

✅️ private theorem cast_numericVal (n m : Int) (h : n = m) (z : Fin (n.natAbs + 1)) :
        (cast (congrArg (fun k : Int => Fin (k.natAbs + 1)) h) z).val = z.val :=
      by
      cases h
      rfl

✅️ noncomputable def smallValue : Term smallField.family
        where
      val x := numericValue (smallIndex.val x)
      property f := cast_numericValue _ _ (smallIndex.property f)

✅️ noncomputable def fieldSection : Term B :=
      Term.map fieldPresentation.inv ((Raising.raiseTerm smallValue).reindex display)

✅️ noncomputable def argument (n : Int) : Term A :=
      Term.map linePresentation.inv (⟨fun _ => ⟨n⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩ : Term (constantFamily _ (ULift.{1} Int)))

✅️ noncomputable def suppliedPair : Term (Presheaf.sigma A B) :=
      sigmaIntro (argument 4) (fieldSection.reindex (pair (𝟙 _) (argument 4)))

✅️ noncomputable def suppliedFunction : Term (Presheaf.pi A B) :=
      lam fieldSection

✅️ noncomputable def initialPair :=
      suppliedPair.reindex (endpointSub Ξ false)

✅️ noncomputable def initialFunction :=
      suppliedFunction.reindex (endpointSub Ξ false)

✅️ noncomputable def pairComparison :=
      LargeConstructors.pairAlongPath carrierPath b initialPair

✅️ noncomputable def functionComparison :=
      LargeConstructors.functionAlongPath carrierPath b initialFunction

✅️ noncomputable def filledPair :=
      LargeConstructors.pairSection a b initialPair

✅️ noncomputable def filledFunction :=
      LargeConstructors.functionSection a b initialFunction

✅️ /-- Natural numeric observation of the varying finite fiber. -/
    noncomputable def smallObserve : smallField.family ⟶ constantFamily (total successorLine.family) Nat
        where
      app _ := TypeCat.ofHom Fin.val
      naturality x y
        f := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro z
        exact cast_numericVal _ _ (smallIndex.property f) z

✅️ noncomputable def fieldObserve : B ⟶ constantFamily (total A) (ULift.{1} Nat) :=
      fieldPresentation.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft display.mapElements (Raising.map smallObserve)

✅️ private def sigmaObserve {Γ : Context.{1}} {C : Family Γ} {D : Family (total C)}
        (o : D ⟶ constantFamily (total C) (ULift.{1} Nat)) : Presheaf.sigma C D ⟶ constantFamily Γ (ULift.{1} Nat)
        where
      app x := TypeCat.ofHom (fun z => o.app (extendObj C x z.1) z.2)
      naturality x y
        f := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro z
        exact o.naturality_apply (extendHom C f z.1) z.2

✅️ private def piObserve {Γ : Context.{1}} {C : Family Γ} {D : Family (total C)}
        (o : D ⟶ constantFamily (total C) (ULift.{1} Nat)) (v : Term C) :
        Presheaf.pi C D ⟶ constantFamily Γ (ULift.{1} Nat)
        where
      app x := TypeCat.ofHom (fun z => o.app (extendObj C x (v.val x)) (z.val (𝟙 x) (v.val x)))
      naturality x y
        f := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro z
        have hn := z.naturality (𝟙 x) f (v.val x)
        have ho := o.naturality_apply (extendHom C f (v.val x)) (z.val (𝟙 x) (v.val x))
        change
          o.app (extendObj C y (C.map f (v.val x))) (D.map (extendHom C f (v.val x)) (z.val (𝟙 x) (v.val x))) = _ at ho
        rw [hn] at ho
        have hc : 𝟙 x ≫ f = f ≫ 𝟙 y := (Category.id_comp f).trans (Category.comp_id f).symm
        rw [hc] at ho
        change o.app (extendObj C y (v.val y)) (z.val (f ≫ 𝟙 y) (v.val y)) = _
        exact (congrArg (fun a => o.app (extendObj C y a) (z.val (f ≫ 𝟙 y) a)) (v.property f)).symm.trans ho

✅️ noncomputable def pairObserve :=
      sigmaObserve fieldObserve

✅️ noncomputable def functionObserve (n : Int) :=
      piObserve fieldObserve (argument n)

✅️ def point : Ξ.Elements :=
      Ξ.elementsMk (Opposite.op ⟨0⟩) ⟨PUnit.unit⟩

✅️ def atEnd (ε : Bool) : (total (interval Ξ)).Elements :=
      (endpointSub Ξ ε).mapElements.obj point

✅️ /-- A constant observation of a section is determined by its initial endpoint. -/
    theorem observe_filling {V : Type 1} {C : Family (total (interval Ξ))}
        (o : C ⟶ constantFamily (total (interval Ξ)) V) (s t : Term C)
        (h : s.reindex (endpointSub Ξ false) = t.reindex (endpointSub Ξ false)) :
        (Term.map o s).val (atEnd true) = (Term.map o t).val (atEnd true) := by
      calc
        _ = (Term.map o s).val (atEnd false) :=
          constant_section_interval _ point ((endpoint Ξ true).val point) ((endpoint Ξ false).val point)
        _ = (Term.map o t).val (atEnd false) := (congrArg (o.app (atEnd false)) (congrArg (fun z => z.val point) h))
        _ = _ := constant_section_interval _ point ((endpoint Ξ false).val point) ((endpoint Ξ true).val point)
✅️ end Examples.CubicalConstructorState
✅️ namespace Examples.CubicalConstructorState
✅️ open CategoryTheory SquareKit.Cubical SquareKit.Cubical.Presheaf
✅️ open CubicalStatePackageUa CubicalStateTransport CubicalUnivalenceTransport CubicalGlue
✅️ open SmallUniverse SmallUniverse.NativeUnivalence

✅️ noncomputable def unglue :
        A ⟶ reindex (liftedDecode (constantLocal terminal Int).code) (projection (interval Ξ)) :=
      Functor.whiskerLeft (raisedIntervalIso terminal).inv.mapElements
        (Raising.map
          (Univalence.unglueLine _ _ (codeIso successor).hom (HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (codeIso successor))))

✅️ private theorem raise_cast {Γ : Context.{0}} {C D : Family Γ} (h : C = D) :
        Raising.map (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (congrArg Raising.family h) :=
      by
      cases h
      rfl

✅️ private theorem raise_comp {Γ : Context.{0}} {C D F : Family Γ} (f : C ⟶ D)
        (g : D ⟶ F) : Raising.map (f ≫ g) = Raising.map f ≫ Raising.map g :=
      rfl
✅️ section
✅️ set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
✅️ end_local_scope 1

✅️ theorem unglue_zero :
        Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ false).mapElements unglue =
          eqToHom (decode_zero carrierPath) ≫ CompositionalUnivalence.nativeMap successor :=
      by
      have h :=
        congrArg Raising.map
          (Univalence.unglueLine_zero _ _ (codeIso successor).hom (HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (codeIso successor)))
      rw [raise_comp, raise_cast] at h
      exact h
✅️ end

✅️ set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    theorem unglue_zero :
        Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ false).mapElements unglue =
          eqToHom (decode_zero carrierPath) ≫ CompositionalUnivalence.nativeMap successor :=
      by
      have h :=
        congrArg Raising.map
          (Univalence.unglueLine_zero _ _ (codeIso successor).hom (HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (codeIso successor)))
      rw [raise_comp, raise_cast] at h
      exact h
✅️ section
✅️ set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
✅️ end_local_scope 1

✅️ theorem unglue_one :
        Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ true).mapElements unglue = eqToHom (decode_one carrierPath) :=
      by
      have h :=
        congrArg Raising.map
          (Univalence.unglueLine_one _ _ (codeIso successor).hom (HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (codeIso successor)))
      rw [raise_cast] at h
      exact h
✅️ end

✅️ set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    theorem unglue_one :
        Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ true).mapElements unglue = eqToHom (decode_one carrierPath) :=
      by
      have h :=
        congrArg Raising.map
          (Univalence.unglueLine_one _ _ (codeIso successor).hom (HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (codeIso successor)))
      rw [raise_cast] at h
      exact h

💥️ noncomputable def carrierComparison (n : Int) :=
      IntervalTransport.mapLineComparisonTo (NativeDecode.filling a) (NativeDecode.filling_lawful a)
        (decode_zero carrierPath) (decode_one carrierPath) unglue (CompositionalUnivalence.nativeMap successor)
        unglue_zero unglue_one (CompositionalUnivalence.nativeInput n)

✅️ /-- Observation distinguishes the actual supplied native ua path from reflexivity. -/
    theorem carrierPath_nonreflexive : carrierPath ≠ homogeneousRefl (term (constantLocal terminal Int).code) :=
      by
      intro h
      have ht := CompositionalUnivalence.observe_path (carrierComparison 3)
      have hr :=
        CompositionalUnivalence.observe_path
          (reflexiveTransportComparison (constantLocal terminal Int).code (CompositionalUnivalence.nativeInput 3))
      have hm :=
        congrArg
          (fun p : Term (paths (constantLocal terminal Int).code (constantLocal terminal Int).code) =>
            CompositionalUnivalence.observe (Term.map (pathToMap p) (CompositionalUnivalence.nativeInput 3)))
          h
      have hf :=
        (congrArg CompositionalUnivalence.observe (CompositionalUnivalence.nativeInput_action successor 3)).trans
          (CompositionalUnivalence.observe_input 4)
      have bad : constantSection (4 : Int) = constantSection 3 :=
        hf.symm.trans (ht.trans (hm.trans (hr.trans (CompositionalUnivalence.observe_input 3))))
      have hv := congrArg (fun t => t.val CubicalStatePackageUa.point) bad
      change (4 : Int) = 3 at hv
      omega
✅️ end Examples.CubicalConstructorState
✅️ namespace Examples.CubicalConstructorState
✅️ open CategoryTheory SquareKit.Cubical SquareKit.Cubical.Presheaf
✅️ open CubicalStatePackageUa CubicalStateTransport CubicalUnivalenceTransport CubicalGlue
✅️ open SmallUniverse

✅️ private theorem iso_apply_inv {Γ : Context.{1}} {C D : Family Γ} (j : C ≅ D)
        (x : Γ.Elements) (z : D.obj x) : j.hom.app x (j.inv.app x z) = z :=
      congrArg (fun k => k.app x z) j.inv_hom_id

✅️ /--
    Observation after the actual dependent-field decoder, at every generalized point. -/
    theorem fieldSection_observation (x : (total A).Elements) :
        (fieldObserve.app x (fieldSection.val x)).down =
          ((linePresentation.hom.app ((projection A).mapElements.obj x) x.val.2).down).natAbs - 1 :=
      by
      change
        ((fieldPresentation.hom.app x
                (fieldPresentation.inv.app x (((Raising.raiseTerm smallValue).reindex display).val x))).down).val =
          _
      rw [iso_apply_inv]
      rfl

✅️ theorem argument_observation (n : Int) (x : (total (interval Ξ)).Elements) :
        linePresentation.hom.app x ((argument n).val x) = ⟨n⟩ :=
      iso_apply_inv linePresentation x ⟨n⟩

✅️ theorem field_argument (n : Int) (x : (total (interval Ξ)).Elements) :
        (fieldObserve.app (extendObj A x ((argument n).val x))
              (fieldSection.val (extendObj A x ((argument n).val x)))).down =
          n.natAbs - 1 :=
      by
      rw [fieldSection_observation]
      exact congrArg (fun z : ULift.{1} Int => z.down.natAbs - 1) (argument_observation n x)

✅️ theorem suppliedPair_observation :
        (Term.map pairObserve suppliedPair).val (atEnd true) = ⟨3⟩ :=
      ULift.ext (field_argument 4 (atEnd true))

✅️ theorem suppliedFunction_observation (n : Int) :
        (Term.map (functionObserve n) suppliedFunction).val (atEnd true) = ⟨n.natAbs - 1⟩ :=
      ULift.ext (field_argument n (atEnd true))

✅️ theorem filledPair_observation :
        (Term.map pairObserve filledPair).val (atEnd true) = ⟨3⟩ :=
      (observe_filling pairObserve filledPair suppliedPair (LargeConstructors.pairSection_zero a b initialPair)).trans
        suppliedPair_observation

✅️ theorem filledFunction_observation :
        (Term.map (functionObserve 4) filledFunction).val (atEnd true) = ⟨3⟩ :=
      (observe_filling (functionObserve 4) filledFunction suppliedFunction
            (LargeConstructors.functionSection_zero a b initialFunction)).trans
        (suppliedFunction_observation 4)

✅️ noncomputable def pairResult :=
      LargeConstructors.sigma a b

✅️ noncomputable def functionResult :=
      LargeConstructors.pi a b

✅️ noncomputable def pairTransported :=
      Term.map (IntervalTransport.map (NativeDecode.filling pairResult.code))
        (Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ false).mapElements pairResult.decoding.inv) initialPair)

✅️ noncomputable def functionTransported :=
      Term.map (IntervalTransport.map (NativeDecode.filling functionResult.code))
        (Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ false).mapElements functionResult.decoding.inv) initialFunction)

✅️ noncomputable def pairOutput :=
      Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ true).mapElements (pairResult.decoding.hom ≫ pairObserve))
        pairTransported

✅️ noncomputable def functionOutput :=
      Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ true).mapElements (functionResult.decoding.hom ≫ functionObserve 4))
        functionTransported

✅️ private theorem decoded_observation {V : Type 1} {Γ : Context.{1}} {C D : Family Γ}
        (j : C ≅ D) (o : D ⟶ constantFamily Γ V) (s : Term C) (t : Term D)
        (p : Term (homogeneousPath C s (Term.map j.inv t))) : Term.map (j.hom ≫ o) s = Term.map o t :=
      by
      have h := discretePath_endpoints (homogeneousPathMap (j.hom ≫ o) p)
      have hr := Term.map_iso_roundtrip j.symm t
      exact h.trans (congrArg (Term.map o) hr)

✅️ private theorem pair_path_observation {V : Type 1} {Ω : Context.{1}}
        {a₀ a₁ : Ω ⟶ smallFamilyCodes.{0}} (p : Term (NativeUnivalence.paths a₀ a₁))
        (d : total (liftedDecode (LargeConstructors.inputLine p)) ⟶ smallFamilyCodes.{0})
        (z :
          Term
            (reindex (Presheaf.sigma (liftedDecode (LargeConstructors.inputLine p)) (liftedDecode d))
              (endpointSub Ω false)))
        (o :
          Presheaf.sigma (liftedDecode (LargeConstructors.inputLine p)) (liftedDecode d) ⟶
            constantFamily (total (interval Ω)) V) :
        let R := LargeConstructors.sigma (LargeConstructors.inputLine p) d
        Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω true).mapElements (R.decoding.hom ≫ o))
            (Term.map (IntervalTransport.map (NativeDecode.filling R.code))
              (Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω false).mapElements R.decoding.inv) z)) =
          (Term.map o (LargeConstructors.pairSection (LargeConstructors.inputLine p) d z)).reindex
            (endpointSub Ω true) :=
      by
      exact
        decoded_observation
          (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω true).mapElements (LargeConstructors.sigma _ d).decoding)
          (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω true).mapElements o) _ _ (LargeConstructors.pairAlongPath p d z)

✅️ private theorem function_path_observation {V : Type 1} {Ω : Context.{1}}
        {a₀ a₁ : Ω ⟶ smallFamilyCodes.{0}} (p : Term (NativeUnivalence.paths a₀ a₁))
        (d : total (liftedDecode (LargeConstructors.inputLine p)) ⟶ smallFamilyCodes.{0})
        (z :
          Term
            (reindex (Presheaf.pi (liftedDecode (LargeConstructors.inputLine p)) (liftedDecode d))
              (endpointSub Ω false)))
        (o :
          Presheaf.pi (liftedDecode (LargeConstructors.inputLine p)) (liftedDecode d) ⟶
            constantFamily (total (interval Ω)) V) :
        let R := LargeConstructors.pi (LargeConstructors.inputLine p) d
        Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω true).mapElements (R.decoding.hom ≫ o))
            (Term.map (IntervalTransport.map (NativeDecode.filling R.code))
              (Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω false).mapElements R.decoding.inv) z)) =
          (Term.map o (LargeConstructors.functionSection (LargeConstructors.inputLine p) d z)).reindex
            (endpointSub Ω true) :=
      by
      exact
        decoded_observation
          (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω true).mapElements (LargeConstructors.pi _ d).decoding)
          (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ω true).mapElements o) _ _ (LargeConstructors.functionAlongPath p d z)

✅️ theorem pairOutput_observation : (pairOutput.val point).down = 3 :=
      by
      have h := pair_path_observation carrierPath b initialPair pairObserve
      exact congrArg (fun t => (t.val point).down) h |>.trans (congrArg ULift.down filledPair_observation)

✅️ /-- The actual universal-decoder Π transport returns the original function at
    its backward argument: target 4 reads source 3. -/
    theorem functionOutput_observation : (functionOutput.val point).down = 3 :=
      by
      have h := function_path_observation carrierPath b initialFunction (functionObserve 4)
      exact congrArg (fun t => (t.val point).down) h |>.trans (congrArg ULift.down filledFunction_observation)

✅️ /-- The endpoint carrier decoder sees the predecessor of the line coordinate. -/
    theorem argument_start (n : Int) :
        startIso.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd false)).down = n - 1 :=
      by
      have he :=
        congrArg (fun j => j.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd false)).down)
          successorLineIso_zero
      have hn := congrArg ULift.down (argument_observation n (atEnd false))
      change successorLineIso.hom.app (endpointPoint false) ((argument n).val (atEnd false)).down = n at hn
      change
        successorLineIso.hom.app (endpointPoint false) _ =
          (show Int from startIso.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd false)).down) + 1 at he
      have hv :
        (show Int from startIso.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd false)).down) + 1 = n :=
        he.symm.trans hn
      change (show Int from startIso.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd false)).down) = n - 1
      omega

✅️ theorem argument_finish (n : Int) :
        finishIso.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd true)).down = n :=
      by
      have he :=
        congrArg (fun j => j.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((argument n).val (atEnd true)).down)
          successorLineIso_one
      exact he.symm.trans (congrArg ULift.down (argument_observation n (atEnd true)))

✅️ /-- Evaluate the actual initial function at source coordinate k, whose line
    coordinate is k+1. `argument_start` checks this indexing through the decoder. -/
    noncomputable def initialOutput (k : Int) : Nat :=
      ((Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ false).mapElements (functionObserve (k + 1))) initialFunction).val
          point).down

✅️ theorem initialOutput_backward : initialOutput 3 = 3 :=
      field_argument 4 (atEnd false)

✅️ theorem initialOutput_unchanged : initialOutput 4 = 4 :=
      field_argument 5 (atEnd false)

✅️ theorem initialOutput_forward : initialOutput 5 = 5 :=
      field_argument 6 (atEnd false)

✅️ /-- The numeric observation separates all three argument directions. -/
    theorem function_direction_sensitive :
        (functionOutput.val point).down = initialOutput (successor.symm 4) ∧
          (functionOutput.val point).down ≠ initialOutput 4 ∧
            (functionOutput.val point).down ≠ initialOutput (successor 4) :=
      by
      change
        (functionOutput.val point).down = initialOutput 3 ∧
          (functionOutput.val point).down ≠ initialOutput 4 ∧ (functionOutput.val point).down ≠ initialOutput 5
      rw [functionOutput_observation, initialOutput_backward, initialOutput_unchanged, initialOutput_forward]
      decide

✅️ /-- The dependent decoder fiber has the cardinality prescribed by its state. -/
    noncomputable def fieldFiber (n : Int) :
        B.obj (extendObj A (atEnd true) ((argument n).val (atEnd true))) ≃ Fin (n.natAbs + 1) :=
      (fieldPresentation.app _).toEquiv.trans
        (Equiv.ulift.trans
          (Equiv.cast
            (congrArg (fun z : ULift.{1} Int => Fin (z.down.natAbs + 1)) (argument_observation n (atEnd true)))))

✅️ /-- The actual field has fibers of different cardinalities, so it is not a
    constant codomain disguised as a dependent function. -/
    theorem field_genuinely_dependent :
        ¬Nonempty
            (B.obj (extendObj A (atEnd true) ((argument 0).val (atEnd true))) ≃
              B.obj (extendObj A (atEnd true) ((argument 1).val (atEnd true)))) :=
      by
      rintro ⟨e⟩
      have h := Fintype.card_congr ((fieldFiber 0).symm.trans (e.trans (fieldFiber 1)))
      simp at h

✅️ private def firstObservation {Γ : Context.{1}} {C : Family Γ} {D : Family (total C)}
        (j : C ⟶ constantFamily Γ (ULift.{1} Int)) : Presheaf.sigma C D ⟶ constantFamily Γ (ULift.{1} Int)
        where
      app x := TypeCat.ofHom (fun z => j.app x z.1)
      naturality x y
        f := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro z
        exact j.naturality_apply f z.1

✅️ noncomputable def pairCarrierObserve :=
      firstObservation (D := B) linePresentation.hom

✅️ noncomputable def pairCarrierOutput :=
      Term.map (Functor.whiskerLeft (endpointSub Ξ true).mapElements (pairResult.decoding.hom ≫ pairCarrierObserve))
        pairTransported

✅️ theorem pairCarrierOutput_observation : (pairCarrierOutput.val point).down = 4 :=
      by
      have h := pair_path_observation carrierPath b initialPair pairCarrierObserve
      have hf :=
        observe_filling pairCarrierObserve filledPair suppliedPair (LargeConstructors.pairSection_zero a b initialPair)
      have hs : (Term.map pairCarrierObserve suppliedPair).val (atEnd true) = ⟨4⟩ := argument_observation 4 (atEnd true)
      exact congrArg (fun t => (t.val point).down) h |>.trans (congrArg ULift.down (hf.trans hs))

✅️ theorem pair_initial_carrier :
        startIso.hom.app CubicalStatePackageUa.point ((initialPair.val point).1).down = (3 : Int) :=
      argument_start 4
✅️ end Examples.CubicalConstructorState

commands.text: ✅️ /-!Independently filled Cartesian packages with complete generalized-function recovery. -/
✅️ set_option autoImplicit false
✅️ set_option warningAsError true
✅️ namespace Examples.CartesianPackageRecomputation
✅️ open CategoryTheory SquareKit.Cubical
✅️ open CartesianWitnessPreservation CubicalStateTransport
✅️ open Cartesian
✅️ variable {Γ : Cartesian.Context.{0}} {A : Cartesian.Family Γ} {S : Type}

✅️ @[ext]
    theorem package_ext {x : Γ.Elements} {p q : TargetPackage A x} (hi : p.initial = q.initial) (hs : p.step = q.step)
        (hv : p.invariant = q.invariant) : p = q := by
      cases p
      cases q
      cases hi
      cases hs
      cases hv
      congr <;> exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

✅️ def fromConstant (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements) (p : StatePackage S) :
        TargetPackage A x where
      initial := e.inv.app x p.initial
      step :=
        { val := fun {y} _ a => e.inv.app y (p.step (e.hom.app y a))
          naturality := by
            intro y z f g a
            change A.map g (e.inv.app y (p.step (e.hom.app y a))) = e.inv.app z (p.step (e.hom.app z (A.map g a)))
            rw [← e.inv.naturality_apply, e.hom.naturality_apply]
            rfl }
      invariant :=
        { val := fun {y} _ a => p.invariant (e.hom.app y a)
          naturality := by
            intro y z f g a
            change p.invariant (e.hom.app y a) = p.invariant (e.hom.app z (A.map g a))
            rw [e.hom.naturality_apply]
            rfl }
      initial_valid :=
        ⟨by
          change p.invariant (e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x p.initial))
          rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
          exact p.initial_valid⟩
      preserves := fun {y} _ a =>
        ⟨by
          change p.invariant (e.hom.app y a) → p.invariant (e.hom.app y (e.inv.app y (p.step (e.hom.app y a))))
          rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
          exact p.preserves _⟩

✅️ def toConstant (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements) (p : TargetPackage A x) :
        StatePackage S :=
      p.readOut.conjugate (e.app x).toEquiv

✅️ theorem to_from (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements) (p : StatePackage S) :
        toConstant e x (fromConstant e x p) = p :=
      by
      apply CubicalStatePackageFamily.statePackage_ext
      · exact e.inv_hom_id_app_apply _ _
      · funext a
        change e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x (p.step (e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x a)))) = p.step a
        rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply, e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
      · funext a
        change p.invariant (e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x a)) = p.invariant a
        rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]

✅️ theorem from_to (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements)
        (p : TargetPackage A x) : fromConstant e x (toConstant e x p) = p :=
      by
      apply package_ext
      · exact e.hom_inv_id_app_apply _ _
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        have lift (s : S) : A.map f (e.inv.app x s) = e.inv.app y s := (e.inv.naturality_apply f s).symm
        have ha : A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)) = a := (lift _).trans (e.hom_inv_id_app_apply _ _)
        have h := p.step.naturality (𝟙 x) f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))
        change
          A.map f (p.step.val (𝟙 x) (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))) =
            p.step.val ((𝟙 x) ≫ f) (A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))) at h
        rw [Category.id_comp, ha] at h
        change e.inv.app y (e.hom.app x (p.step.val (𝟙 x) (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)))) = _
        exact (lift _).symm.trans ((congrArg (A.map f) (e.hom_inv_id_app_apply x _)).trans h)
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        have ha : A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)) = a :=
          (e.inv.naturality_apply f _).symm.trans (e.hom_inv_id_app_apply _ _)
        have h := p.invariant.naturality (𝟙 x) f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))
        change
          p.invariant.val (𝟙 x) (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)) =
            p.invariant.val ((𝟙 x) ≫ f) (A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))) at h
        rw [Category.id_comp, ha] at h
        exact h

✅️ def packageRestrict {x y : Γ.Elements} (f : x ⟶ y) (p : TargetPackage A x) :
        TargetPackage A y where
      initial := A.map f p.initial
      step := p.step.restrict f
      invariant := p.invariant.restrict f
      initial_valid :=
        ⟨by
          have h := p.invariant.naturality (𝟙 x) f p.initial
          change p.invariant.val (𝟙 x) p.initial = p.invariant.val ((𝟙 x) ≫ f) (A.map f p.initial) at h
          change p.invariant.val (f ≫ 𝟙 y) (A.map f p.initial)
          rw [Category.id_comp] at h
          rw [Category.comp_id, ← h]
          exact p.initial_valid.down⟩
      preserves := fun g a => p.preserves (f ≫ g) a

✅️ def packageFamily (A : Cartesian.Family Γ) : Cartesian.Family Γ
        where
      obj x := TargetPackage A x
      map f := TypeCat.ofHom (packageRestrict f)
      map_id
        x := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro p
        apply package_ext
        · exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (A.map_id x) p.initial
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y f a
          exact congrArg (fun g => p.step.val g a) (Category.id_comp f)
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y f a
          exact congrArg (fun g => p.invariant.val g a) (Category.id_comp f)
      map_comp f
        g := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro p
        apply package_ext
        · exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (A.map_comp f g) p.initial
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y h a
          exact congrArg (fun k => p.step.val k a) (Category.assoc f g h)
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y h a
          exact congrArg (fun k => p.invariant.val k a) (Category.assoc f g h)

✅️ theorem fromConstant_natural (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) {x y : Γ.Elements}
        (f : x ⟶ y) (p : StatePackage S) : packageRestrict f (fromConstant e x p) = fromConstant e y p :=
      by
      apply package_ext
      · exact (e.inv.naturality_apply f p.initial).symm
      · rfl
      · rfl

✅️ /--
    Classification retains both generalized functions and both dependent proof fields. -/
    def packagePresentation (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) : packageFamily A ≅ constantFamily Γ (StatePackage S) :=
      (NatIso.ofComponents (F := constantFamily Γ (StatePackage S)) (G := packageFamily A)
          (fun x =>
            (show StatePackage S ≃ TargetPackage A x from
                { toFun := fromConstant e x
                  invFun := toConstant e x
                  left_inv := to_from e x
                  right_inv := from_to e x }).toIso)
          (by
            intro x y f
            apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
            intro p
            exact (fromConstant_natural e f p).symm)).symm

✅️ def pullTargetPackage (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (p : StatePackage S) :
        Cartesian.Term (packageFamily A) :=
      Cartesian.Term.map (packagePresentation e).inv ⟨fun _ => p, fun _ => rfl⟩

✅️ def emptySubcontext (Γ : Cartesian.Context.{0}) : Subcontext Γ
        where
      holds _ := False
      natural _ := False.elim

✅️ def packageBox {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))}
        (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S) (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) :
        OpenBox (packageFamily A) (emptySubcontext Γ) r
        where
      tube := { val := fun _ h => h.elim, natural := fun _ h => h.elim }
      base := Cartesian.Term.reindex (pullTargetPackage e p) (graph r)
      boundary _ h := h.elim

✅️ /-- Recompute by the target all-box operation, supplied only the source graph. -/
    def recomputed {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))} (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S)
        (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) : Cartesian.Term (packageFamily A) :=
      (packageBox e r p).presentedFill (packagePresentation e)

✅️ theorem recomputed_eq {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))}
        (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S) (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) :
        recomputed e r p = pullTargetPackage e p :=
      ((packageBox e r p).presentedFill_unique (packagePresentation e) (pullTargetPackage e p) rfl).symm

✅️ theorem recomputed_fills
        {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))} (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S)
        (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) :
        (packageBox e r p).Fills (recomputed e r p) :=
      (packageBox e r p).presentedFill_fills (packagePresentation e)

✅️ theorem source_pull_comparison {Δ : Presheaf.Context.{0}} (A : Presheaf.LocalFamily Δ)
        (e : A.family ≅ Presheaf.constantFamily Δ S) (p : StatePackage S) (τ : Γ ⟶ Cartesian.restrict Δ)
        (x : Γ.Elements) :
        (packageComparison A (τ.mapElements.obj x)
                ((CubicalStatePackageFamily.pullPackage A e p).val
                  ((Cartesian.elements Δ).obj (τ.mapElements.obj x)))).reindex
            τ x =
          fromConstant (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft τ.mapElements (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Cartesian.elements Δ) e)) x p :=
      by
      apply package_ext
      · rfl
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        rfl
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        rfl

✅️ theorem package_filling_lawful (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) :
        (presentedFilling (packagePresentation e)).Lawful :=
      presentedFilling_lawful (packagePresentation e)

✅️ theorem pullTargetPackage_reindex {Δ : Cartesian.Context.{0}}
        (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (p : StatePackage S) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (x : Δ.Elements) :
        ((pullTargetPackage e p).val (σ.mapElements.obj x)).reindex σ x =
          (pullTargetPackage (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft σ.mapElements e) p).val x :=
      by apply package_ext <;> rfl

✅️ theorem recomputed_reindex {Δ : Cartesian.Context.{0}}
        {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))} (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S)
        (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ)
        (x : (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Δ)).Elements) :
        ((recomputed e r p).val ((intervalSub σ).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub σ) x =
          (recomputed (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub σ).mapElements e) (Cartesian.Term.reindex r σ) p).val x :=
      by
      exact
        (congrArg
              (fun t : Cartesian.Term (packageFamily A) =>
                (t.val ((intervalSub σ).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub σ) x)
              (recomputed_eq e r p)).trans
          ((pullTargetPackage_reindex e p (intervalSub σ) x).trans
            (congrArg (fun t => t.val x)
                (recomputed_eq (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub σ).mapElements e) (Cartesian.Term.reindex r σ)
                  p)).symm)

✅️ def endpointTerm (Γ : Cartesian.Context.{0}) (b : Bool) :
        Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)
        where
      val x := ⟨Cartesian.Cube.endpoint x.obj.unop b⟩
      property _ := rfl
✅️ open CubicalFiniteStateIdentity CubicalStructuredState

✅️ noncomputable def selectedCarrier :=
      Cartesian.relativeFamily
        (admittedLine (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence).family

✅️ noncomputable def selectedPresentation :
        selectedCarrier ≅
          constantFamily (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal))) Phase :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Cartesian.intervalElements Presheaf.terminal)
        (admittedPresentation (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)

✅️ noncomputable def selectedHostPackage :=
      machine.conjugate (admittedCarrier (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)

✅️ noncomputable def recomputedSelected :
        Cartesian.Term (packageFamily selectedCarrier) :=
      recomputed selectedPresentation (endpointTerm (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal) false) selectedHostPackage

✅️ /--
    Exact equality includes the operation and invariant at every generalized input. -/
    theorem recomputedSelected_eq
        (x : (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal))).Elements) :
        recomputedSelected.val x = cartesianPackage x :=
      by
      rw [recomputedSelected, recomputed_eq]
      change fromConstant selectedPresentation x selectedHostPackage = _
      have h :=
        source_pull_comparison (admittedLine (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)
          (admittedPresentation (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)
          selectedHostPackage (Cartesian.intervalContextInclusion Presheaf.terminal) x
      have hr := transported_recovery (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence machine
      change
        fromConstant selectedPresentation x selectedHostPackage =
          (packageComparison _ ((Cartesian.intervalContextInclusion Presheaf.terminal).mapElements.obj x)
                (frozenPackage.val ((Cartesian.intervalElements Presheaf.terminal).obj x))).reindex
            (Cartesian.intervalContextInclusion Presheaf.terminal) x
      rw [show frozenPackage = _ from hr]
      exact h.symm

✅️ /-- Recomputing after a base change preserves the entire selected package. -/
    theorem recomputedSelected_reindex {Δ : Cartesian.Context.{0}} (σ : Δ ⟶ Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal)
        (x : (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Δ)).Elements) :
        (recomputed (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub σ).mapElements selectedPresentation)
                (Cartesian.Term.reindex (endpointTerm (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal) false) σ)
                selectedHostPackage).val
            x =
          (cartesianPackage ((intervalSub σ).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub σ) x :=
      by
      rw [← recomputed_reindex, ← recomputedSelected_eq]
      rfl

✅️ /-- Two actual interval projections preserve the freshly recomputed package. -/
    theorem recomputedSelected_two_projections (x) :
        let τ := Cartesian.projection (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal));
        let σ :=
          Cartesian.projection
            (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal))));
        (recomputed (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub (σ ≫ τ)).mapElements selectedPresentation)
                (Cartesian.Term.reindex (endpointTerm (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal) false) (σ ≫ τ))
                selectedHostPackage).val
            x =
          (cartesianPackage ((intervalSub (σ ≫ τ)).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub (σ ≫ τ)) x :=
      recomputedSelected_reindex _ x

✅️ noncomputable def recomputedFinish : StatePackage Phase :=
      (recomputedSelected.val (targetEndpoint true)).readOut.conjugate
        ((admittedFinish (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence).app
            Presheaf.DiscreteEquivalences.point).toEquiv

✅️ theorem recomputedFinish_eq : recomputedFinish = machineTransported :=
      by
      unfold recomputedFinish
      rw [recomputedSelected_eq]
      exact cartesianFinish_eq

✅️ theorem recomputed_observation :
        observer (recomputedFinish.step recomputedFinish.initial) = 1 :=
      by
      rw [recomputedFinish_eq]
      exact transported_observation

✅️ theorem recomputed_invariant :
        recomputedFinish.invariant .ready ∧ ¬recomputedFinish.invariant .failed :=
      by
      rw [recomputedFinish_eq]
      exact transported_invariant

✅️ theorem recomputed_wrong_transition :
        wrongPresentation (machine.step 0) ≠ recomputedFinish.step (wrongPresentation 0) :=
      by
      rw [recomputedFinish_eq, machineTransported_eq]
      exact wrong_transition
✅️ end Examples.CartesianPackageRecomputation
✅️ namespace Examples.CartesianPackageRecomputation.NativeRecords
✅️ open CategoryTheory SquareKit.Cubical SquareKit.Cubical.Presheaf
✅️ open SmallUniverse SmallUniverse.NativeUnivalence
✅️ open Examples.CompositionalUnivalence

✅️ def presentation (S : Type) :
        liftedDecode (code S) ≅ constantFamily (raisedContext terminal) (ULift.{1} S) :=
      Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalGlue.constantLocal terminal S).decodeCodeIso

✅️ theorem inverse_record {S T : Type} (e : S ≃ T) :
        (⟨inverseMap (code S) (code T) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e),
              inverseEquivalence (code S) (code T) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e)⟩ :
            Σ f : liftedDecode (code T) ⟶ liftedDecode (code S), HomotopyEquivalence f) =
          ⟨(Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)).inv,
            HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)).symm⟩ :=
      DiscreteRecords.universeInverse_record (code S) (code T) (presentation S) (presentation T)
        (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)) (nativeEquivalence e)

✅️ theorem inverse_recipes {S T : Type} (e : S ≃ T) :
        (nativeEquivalence e).discreteInverse = inverseMap (code S) (code T) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e) :=
      DiscreteRecords.inverseRecipes_eq (code S) (code T) (presentation S) (presentation T)
        (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)) (nativeEquivalence e)

✅️ theorem composite_record {S T V : Type} (e : S ≃ T) (d : T ≃ V) :
        (⟨nativeMap e ≫ nativeMap d,
              compositeEquivalence (code S) (code T) (code V) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e) (nativeMap d)
                (nativeEquivalence d)⟩ :
            Σ f : liftedDecode (code S) ⟶ liftedDecode (code V), HomotopyEquivalence f) =
          ⟨(Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e) ≪≫
                Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso d)).hom,
            HomotopyEquivalence.ofIso
              (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e) ≪≫
                Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso d))⟩ :=
      DiscreteRecords.universeComposite_record (code S) (code T) (code V) (presentation S) (presentation V)
        (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e))
        (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso d)) (nativeEquivalence e) (nativeEquivalence d)

✅️ theorem inverse_recomputed {S T : Type} (e : S ≃ T) :
        restrictRecord
            ⟨inverseMap (code S) (code T) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e),
              inverseEquivalence (code S) (code T) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e)⟩ =
          ⟨(Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)).inv,
            Cartesian.recomputeEquivalence (presentation S)
              (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)).symm⟩ :=
      by
      have h := congrArg restrictRecord (inverse_record e)
      exact
        h.trans
          (congrArg (Sigma.mk _)
            (Cartesian.recomputeEquivalence_eq (presentation S)
                (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e)).symm _).symm)

✅️ theorem composite_recomputed {S T V : Type} (e : S ≃ T) (d : T ≃ V) :
        restrictRecord
            ⟨nativeMap e ≫ nativeMap d,
              compositeEquivalence (code S) (code T) (code V) (nativeMap e) (nativeEquivalence e) (nativeMap d)
                (nativeEquivalence d)⟩ =
          ⟨(Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e) ≪≫
                Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso d)).hom,
            Cartesian.recomputeEquivalence (presentation V)
              (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e) ≪≫
                Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso d))⟩ :=
      by
      have h := congrArg restrictRecord (composite_record e d)
      exact
        h.trans
          (congrArg (Sigma.mk _)
            (Cartesian.recomputeEquivalence_eq (presentation V)
                (Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso e) ≪≫
                  Raising.iso (Examples.CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso d))
                _).symm)

✅️ example :
        (nativeEquivalence Examples.FiniteUniverseLoops.swap01).discreteInverse =
          inverseMap (code (Fin 3)) (code (Fin 3)) (nativeMap Examples.FiniteUniverseLoops.swap01)
            (nativeEquivalence Examples.FiniteUniverseLoops.swap01) :=
      inverse_recipes _
✅️ end Examples.CartesianPackageRecomputation.NativeRecords

command_traces.text: ✅️ /-!Independently filled Cartesian packages with complete generalized-function recovery. -/
✅️ set_option autoImplicit false
✅️ set_option warningAsError true
✅️ namespace Examples.CartesianPackageRecomputation
✅️ open CategoryTheory SquareKit.Cubical
✅️ open CartesianWitnessPreservation CubicalStateTransport
✅️ open Cartesian
✅️ variable {Γ : Cartesian.Context.{0}} {A : Cartesian.Family Γ} {S : Type}

✅️ @[ext]
    theorem package_ext {x : Γ.Elements} {p q : TargetPackage A x} (hi : p.initial = q.initial) (hs : p.step = q.step)
        (hv : p.invariant = q.invariant) : p = q := by
      cases p
      cases q
      cases hi
      cases hs
      cases hv
      congr <;> exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

✅️ def fromConstant (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements) (p : StatePackage S) :
        TargetPackage A x where
      initial := e.inv.app x p.initial
      step :=
        { val := fun {y} _ a => e.inv.app y (p.step (e.hom.app y a))
          naturality := by
            intro y z f g a
            change A.map g (e.inv.app y (p.step (e.hom.app y a))) = e.inv.app z (p.step (e.hom.app z (A.map g a)))
            rw [← e.inv.naturality_apply, e.hom.naturality_apply]
            rfl }
      invariant :=
        { val := fun {y} _ a => p.invariant (e.hom.app y a)
          naturality := by
            intro y z f g a
            change p.invariant (e.hom.app y a) = p.invariant (e.hom.app z (A.map g a))
            rw [e.hom.naturality_apply]
            rfl }
      initial_valid :=
        ⟨by
          change p.invariant (e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x p.initial))
          rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
          exact p.initial_valid⟩
      preserves := fun {y} _ a =>
        ⟨by
          change p.invariant (e.hom.app y a) → p.invariant (e.hom.app y (e.inv.app y (p.step (e.hom.app y a))))
          rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
          exact p.preserves _⟩

✅️ def toConstant (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements) (p : TargetPackage A x) :
        StatePackage S :=
      p.readOut.conjugate (e.app x).toEquiv

✅️ theorem to_from (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements) (p : StatePackage S) :
        toConstant e x (fromConstant e x p) = p :=
      by
      apply CubicalStatePackageFamily.statePackage_ext
      · exact e.inv_hom_id_app_apply _ _
      · funext a
        change e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x (p.step (e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x a)))) = p.step a
        rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply, e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
      · funext a
        change p.invariant (e.hom.app x (e.inv.app x a)) = p.invariant a
        rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]

✅️ theorem from_to (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (x : Γ.Elements)
        (p : TargetPackage A x) : fromConstant e x (toConstant e x p) = p :=
      by
      apply package_ext
      · exact e.hom_inv_id_app_apply _ _
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        have lift (s : S) : A.map f (e.inv.app x s) = e.inv.app y s := (e.inv.naturality_apply f s).symm
        have ha : A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)) = a := (lift _).trans (e.hom_inv_id_app_apply _ _)
        have h := p.step.naturality (𝟙 x) f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))
        change
          A.map f (p.step.val (𝟙 x) (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))) =
            p.step.val ((𝟙 x) ≫ f) (A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))) at h
        rw [Category.id_comp, ha] at h
        change e.inv.app y (e.hom.app x (p.step.val (𝟙 x) (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)))) = _
        exact (lift _).symm.trans ((congrArg (A.map f) (e.hom_inv_id_app_apply x _)).trans h)
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        have ha : A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)) = a :=
          (e.inv.naturality_apply f _).symm.trans (e.hom_inv_id_app_apply _ _)
        have h := p.invariant.naturality (𝟙 x) f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))
        change
          p.invariant.val (𝟙 x) (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a)) =
            p.invariant.val ((𝟙 x) ≫ f) (A.map f (e.inv.app x (e.hom.app y a))) at h
        rw [Category.id_comp, ha] at h
        exact h

✅️ def packageRestrict {x y : Γ.Elements} (f : x ⟶ y) (p : TargetPackage A x) :
        TargetPackage A y where
      initial := A.map f p.initial
      step := p.step.restrict f
      invariant := p.invariant.restrict f
      initial_valid :=
        ⟨by
          have h := p.invariant.naturality (𝟙 x) f p.initial
          change p.invariant.val (𝟙 x) p.initial = p.invariant.val ((𝟙 x) ≫ f) (A.map f p.initial) at h
          change p.invariant.val (f ≫ 𝟙 y) (A.map f p.initial)
          rw [Category.id_comp] at h
          rw [Category.comp_id, ← h]
          exact p.initial_valid.down⟩
      preserves := fun g a => p.preserves (f ≫ g) a

✅️ def packageFamily (A : Cartesian.Family Γ) : Cartesian.Family Γ
        where
      obj x := TargetPackage A x
      map f := TypeCat.ofHom (packageRestrict f)
      map_id
        x := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro p
        apply package_ext
        · exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (A.map_id x) p.initial
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y f a
          exact congrArg (fun g => p.step.val g a) (Category.id_comp f)
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y f a
          exact congrArg (fun g => p.invariant.val g a) (Category.id_comp f)
      map_comp f
        g := by
        apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
        intro p
        apply package_ext
        · exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (A.map_comp f g) p.initial
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y h a
          exact congrArg (fun k => p.step.val k a) (Category.assoc f g h)
        · apply PiElement.ext
          intro y h a
          exact congrArg (fun k => p.invariant.val k a) (Category.assoc f g h)

✅️ theorem fromConstant_natural (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) {x y : Γ.Elements}
        (f : x ⟶ y) (p : StatePackage S) : packageRestrict f (fromConstant e x p) = fromConstant e y p :=
      by
      apply package_ext
      · exact (e.inv.naturality_apply f p.initial).symm
      · rfl
      · rfl

✅️ /--
    Classification retains both generalized functions and both dependent proof fields. -/
    def packagePresentation (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) : packageFamily A ≅ constantFamily Γ (StatePackage S) :=
      (NatIso.ofComponents (F := constantFamily Γ (StatePackage S)) (G := packageFamily A)
          (fun x =>
            (show StatePackage S ≃ TargetPackage A x from
                { toFun := fromConstant e x
                  invFun := toConstant e x
                  left_inv := to_from e x
                  right_inv := from_to e x }).toIso)
          (by
            intro x y f
            apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
            intro p
            exact (fromConstant_natural e f p).symm)).symm

✅️ def pullTargetPackage (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (p : StatePackage S) :
        Cartesian.Term (packageFamily A) :=
      Cartesian.Term.map (packagePresentation e).inv ⟨fun _ => p, fun _ => rfl⟩

✅️ def emptySubcontext (Γ : Cartesian.Context.{0}) : Subcontext Γ
        where
      holds _ := False
      natural _ := False.elim

✅️ def packageBox {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))}
        (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S) (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) :
        OpenBox (packageFamily A) (emptySubcontext Γ) r
        where
      tube := { val := fun _ h => h.elim, natural := fun _ h => h.elim }
      base := Cartesian.Term.reindex (pullTargetPackage e p) (graph r)
      boundary _ h := h.elim

✅️ /-- Recompute by the target all-box operation, supplied only the source graph. -/
    def recomputed {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))} (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S)
        (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) : Cartesian.Term (packageFamily A) :=
      (packageBox e r p).presentedFill (packagePresentation e)

✅️ theorem recomputed_eq {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))}
        (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S) (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) :
        recomputed e r p = pullTargetPackage e p :=
      ((packageBox e r p).presentedFill_unique (packagePresentation e) (pullTargetPackage e p) rfl).symm

✅️ theorem recomputed_fills
        {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))} (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S)
        (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) :
        (packageBox e r p).Fills (recomputed e r p) :=
      (packageBox e r p).presentedFill_fills (packagePresentation e)

✅️ theorem source_pull_comparison {Δ : Presheaf.Context.{0}} (A : Presheaf.LocalFamily Δ)
        (e : A.family ≅ Presheaf.constantFamily Δ S) (p : StatePackage S) (τ : Γ ⟶ Cartesian.restrict Δ)
        (x : Γ.Elements) :
        (packageComparison A (τ.mapElements.obj x)
                ((CubicalStatePackageFamily.pullPackage A e p).val
                  ((Cartesian.elements Δ).obj (τ.mapElements.obj x)))).reindex
            τ x =
          fromConstant (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft τ.mapElements (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Cartesian.elements Δ) e)) x p :=
      by
      apply package_ext
      · rfl
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        rfl
      · apply PiElement.ext
        intro y f a
        rfl

✅️ theorem package_filling_lawful (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) :
        (presentedFilling (packagePresentation e)).Lawful :=
      presentedFilling_lawful (packagePresentation e)

✅️ theorem pullTargetPackage_reindex {Δ : Cartesian.Context.{0}}
        (e : A ≅ constantFamily Γ S) (p : StatePackage S) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (x : Δ.Elements) :
        ((pullTargetPackage e p).val (σ.mapElements.obj x)).reindex σ x =
          (pullTargetPackage (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft σ.mapElements e) p).val x :=
      by apply package_ext <;> rfl

✅️ theorem recomputed_reindex {Δ : Cartesian.Context.{0}}
        {A : Cartesian.Family (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Γ))} (e : A ≅ constantFamily _ S)
        (r : Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)) (p : StatePackage S) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ)
        (x : (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Δ)).Elements) :
        ((recomputed e r p).val ((intervalSub σ).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub σ) x =
          (recomputed (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub σ).mapElements e) (Cartesian.Term.reindex r σ) p).val x :=
      by
      exact
        (congrArg
              (fun t : Cartesian.Term (packageFamily A) =>
                (t.val ((intervalSub σ).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub σ) x)
              (recomputed_eq e r p)).trans
          ((pullTargetPackage_reindex e p (intervalSub σ) x).trans
            (congrArg (fun t => t.val x)
                (recomputed_eq (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub σ).mapElements e) (Cartesian.Term.reindex r σ)
                  p)).symm)

✅️ def endpointTerm (Γ : Cartesian.Context.{0}) (b : Bool) :
        Cartesian.Term (Cartesian.interval Γ)
        where
      val x := ⟨Cartesian.Cube.endpoint x.obj.unop b⟩
      property _ := rfl
✅️ open CubicalFiniteStateIdentity CubicalStructuredState

✅️ noncomputable def selectedCarrier :=
      Cartesian.relativeFamily
        (admittedLine (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence).family

✅️ noncomputable def selectedPresentation :
        selectedCarrier ≅
          constantFamily (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal))) Phase :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Cartesian.intervalElements Presheaf.terminal)
        (admittedPresentation (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)

✅️ noncomputable def selectedHostPackage :=
      machine.conjugate (admittedCarrier (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)

✅️ noncomputable def recomputedSelected :
        Cartesian.Term (packageFamily selectedCarrier) :=
      recomputed selectedPresentation (endpointTerm (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal) false) selectedHostPackage

✅️ /--
    Exact equality includes the operation and invariant at every generalized input. -/
    theorem recomputedSelected_eq
        (x : (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal))).Elements) :
        recomputedSelected.val x = cartesianPackage x :=
      by
      rw [recomputedSelected, recomputed_eq]
      change fromConstant selectedPresentation x selectedHostPackage = _
      have h :=
        source_pull_comparison (admittedLine (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)
          (admittedPresentation (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence)
          selectedHostPackage (Cartesian.intervalContextInclusion Presheaf.terminal) x
      have hr := transported_recovery (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence machine
      change
        fromConstant selectedPresentation x selectedHostPackage =
          (packageComparison _ ((Cartesian.intervalContextInclusion Presheaf.terminal).mapElements.obj x)
                (frozenPackage.val ((Cartesian.intervalElements Presheaf.terminal).obj x))).reindex
            (Cartesian.intervalContextInclusion Presheaf.terminal) x
      rw [show frozenPackage = _ from hr]
      exact h.symm

✅️ /-- Recomputing after a base change preserves the entire selected package. -/
    theorem recomputedSelected_reindex {Δ : Cartesian.Context.{0}} (σ : Δ ⟶ Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal)
        (x : (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval Δ)).Elements) :
        (recomputed (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub σ).mapElements selectedPresentation)
                (Cartesian.Term.reindex (endpointTerm (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal) false) σ)
                selectedHostPackage).val
            x =
          (cartesianPackage ((intervalSub σ).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub σ) x :=
      by
      rw [← recomputed_reindex, ← recomputedSelected_eq]
      rfl

✅️ /-- Two actual interval projections preserve the freshly recomputed package. -/
    theorem recomputedSelected_two_projections (x) :
        let τ := Cartesian.projection (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal));
        let σ :=
          Cartesian.projection
            (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.total (Cartesian.interval (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal))));
        (recomputed (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (intervalSub (σ ≫ τ)).mapElements selectedPresentation)
                (Cartesian.Term.reindex (endpointTerm (Cartesian.restrict Presheaf.terminal) false) (σ ≫ τ))
                selectedHostPackage).val
            x =
          (cartesianPackage ((intervalSub (σ ≫ τ)).mapElements.obj x)).reindex (intervalSub (σ ≫ τ)) x :=
      recomputedSelected_reindex _ x

✅️ noncomputable def recomputedFinish : StatePackage Phase :=
      (recomputedSelected.val (targetEndpoint true)).readOut.conjugate
        ((admittedFinish (CubicalUnivalenceTransport.codeIso presentation).hom nativeEquivalence).app
            Presheaf.DiscreteEquivalences.point).toEquiv

✅️ theorem recomputedFinish_eq : recomputedFinish = machineTransported :=
      by
      unfold recomputedFinish
      rw [recomputedSelected_eq]
      exact cartesianFinish_eq

✅️ theorem recomputed_observation :
